question:
The figure is an aerial photo of a parking lot. Overlay a 5x5 grid on the image: cell (r, c) means row r counting from the top and column c counting from the left, both 1-based. How many cars have their centre inside cell (4, 1)?
(A) 6
(B) 4
(C) 3
(D) 2

Answer with only the correct option letter.
